# Command line and lint {#cli}

Tooling specifies the 0.2 commands every engine offers: `render`, `ast`, `fmt`, `lint`, `diagnostics`, `import`, `migrate-ast`, `flatten` and `fix`. The reference engine adds `upgrade`.

Most 0.1 flags keep their names. The ones that move: `--json` and `--ast` become `carve ast`; `migrate --from html` becomes `carve import --from html`, and `migrate --from markdown` becomes `carve import --from gfm`; `--no-raw-html` and `--safe` are the default, and `--raw-html` turns raw HTML on; `fmt --migrate` becomes `carve upgrade --migrate`. The 0.1 `merge` and `trace` commands have no 0.2 replacement: 0.2 has no three-way merge (C2-T-044) and no portable decision trace. `carve lint` exits with 1 only for a warning or an error, so a hint never fails a CI job; `--strict` restores the 0.1 status (C2-T-031, C2-T-051). The full flag table is in Command line and missing features.

**U-372** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> Consecutive marker-shaped paragraph lines: `a` then `- b` then `- c`
Tool: Each marker-shaped line reports; HTML is unchanged.

::: compare no-render
```text
a
- b
- c
```
```text
0.2 reports each marker-shaped paragraph line; 0.1 reported only the first line of the run. The HTML is unchanged.
```
:::

**U-373** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> Consecutive table-shaped paragraph lines: `\| a` then `\| b`
Tool: Each table-shaped line reports; HTML is unchanged.

::: compare no-render
```text
| a
| b
```
```text
0.2 reports each table-shaped paragraph line; 0.1 reported only the first line of the run. The HTML is unchanged.
```
:::

**U-421** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> The loss allow list of the 0.1 command line, `--allow-loss CODE`

**U-422** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> The 0.1 cap on retained losses, `maxRenderLosses` and `--max-render-losses`, default 100
